description: CAPTURE-SPEC C7: System.Math transcendental results, float32 expression evaluation mode, numeric conversions, number formatting/parsing and System.Random, as evaluated by the runtime named in provenance.runtime. The same source file (HarnessCaptureC7.cs) runs in KSP's Mono (Assembly-CSharp, profiling branch) and in the .NET Framework 4.8 x64 reference tool, so any difference is the runtime's.
oracles: System.Math.* (Sin Cos Tan Asin Acos Atan Atan2 Sinh Cosh Tanh Exp Log Log10 Sqrt Pow Floor Ceiling Round IEEERemainder), C# % on double/float
C# float32 expressions compiled by Roslyn, executed by the runtime's JIT
C# numeric conversions (unchecked), double/float ToString/Parse (InvariantCulture), System.Random

provenance.decimal_format: normalized from _hex by harness/captures/tools/normalize.py (harness ExactNumber.FormatFloat/FormatDouble on .NET Framework ToString G6..G9 / G15..G17)

tables.name: f64
tables.description: System.Math on double inputs. i indexes libm_inputs.tsv (x); y is the second argument where there is one.

tables.name: f32
tables.description: float32 wrappers of System.Math on f = (float)x (Mathf bodies), plus float %.

tables.name: f32ops
tables.description: float32 expression probes over f32_inputs.tsv rows (a,b,c,d,e,x). poly: ((x*1.1f+0.3f)*x-0.7f)/3.3f; dot2: a*b+c*d-e; cast_each: (float)((float)((float)(a*b)+(float)(c*d))-e); acc_loop: 16x acc=acc*0.999f+a*b; dot2_call: same as dot2 in a NoInlining method; locals: t1=a*b; t2=c*d; t1+t2-e; sqrt_div: (float)Math.Sqrt(a*a+b*b)/c; compare: (a*b+c == p+c) with float p=a*b, as 1/0; arg_noinline / arg_inline: AddNI(a*b, c) / AddAI(a*b, c) (float p+q in a NoInlining / AggressiveInlining method).

tables.name: f32ops_wide
tables.description: float32 expressions assigned to double. mul_wide: double r = a*b; muladd_wide: double r = a*b+c. With per-operation float32 rounding r is the float32-rounded value; with double intermediates it is the exact product. ret_noinline / ret_inline: double r = MulNI(a,b) / MulAI(a,b) (float p*q returned from a NoInlining / AggressiveInlining method); field / struct_field / static_field / local: a*b stored to a float class field / local struct field / static field / local, read back as double.

tables.name: conv
tables.description: Unchecked C# conversions of special doubles/floats to integers (the ECMA spec leaves out-of-range and NaN results unspecified).

tables.name: iconv
tables.description: Integer to floating-point conversions. v is the integer (decimal string, unsigned for ulong rows).

tables.name: tostring
tables.description: double/float formatting with InvariantCulture; rt = Parse(s) gives back the same bits.

tables.name: parse
tables.description: float.Parse / double.Parse(s, NumberStyles.Float|AllowThousands, InvariantCulture) of every numeric token in the curves_eval cfg keys plus edge cases (parse_tokens.tsv).

tables.name: sysrand
tables.description: System.Random(seed): independent generators for each column (Next(), NextDouble(), Next(0,100), Next(-1000,1000)).
